summary: Frontend-only test focused on the reported homepage budget slider bug + full page/nav sweep. Both budget sliders (Home 'filter-budget' and Search '/search sr-budget') render TWO independent draggable thumbs. Dragging each thumb via keyboard and physical mouse drag updates only that thumb and the associated label (£min ↔ £max). Search filtering by budget works — dragging right thumb from 400 to ~£165 reduces visible cars from 48 to 12. Top nav order confirmed exactly as expected with 'For drivers' as rightmost item, and every nav testid routes to the correct page. All 20 pages in the requested sweep render real content with header/footer, no page errors, no blank screens. /portal correctly redirects to /login when unauthenticated (expected auth guard). /admin renders the admin login page correctly despite the '*' catch-all being declared above the /admin route (React Router v6 picks the more specific match, so no bug). For Drivers page renders with hero, 'GPS-tracked' benefit card, CTAs (Browse cars, Create your free account, See the full guide). Footer social anchors present (instagram/facebook/linkedin).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js declares <Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/'/>} /> BEFORE the /admin route (line 66 vs line 67). It currently works because React Router v6 uses ranked matching, but this is fragile/misleading. Move the '*' catch-all to be the last route to avoid future confusion.

SearchResults.jsx run() depends on `range` but the useEffect on line 33 uses `[]` and does not re-run on range change automatically — user must press 'Update results' (this is by design, but worth noting; the initial URL-provided min/max is applied on first load via run() which uses the current state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slider component (components/ui/slider.jsx) now maps a Thumb per value entry — verified working with two thumbs on both Home and Search. Nav has 5 items in order: Search cars, Why Kharo, How it works, For operators, For drivers. All 20 routes render. If any of these regress, retest with the same Playwright approach (query [role='slider'] children of the slider testid to count thumbs; use keyboard ArrowLeft/Right on focused thumbs for deterministic testing).
rca_of_the_issue: User reported homepage 'weekly budget' slider was glitched — NOT REPRODUCIBLE. slider.jsx renders one <SliderPrimitive.Thumb> per value in props.value/defaultValue, and Home.jsx passes value={[min,max]} with min=0/max=400/step=5 and minStepsBetweenThumbs=1. Both thumbs move independently by keyboard and by mouse drag; label 'Weekly budget: £X to £Y' updates only the corresponding side. Fix from previous iteration is verified in place and working.
